messages.content: 以每分鐘95拍的速度創作一個嘻哈的節拍，使用大調音階，並用C4、E4、F4、G4創作一個貝斯的旋律。

function.name: melody_generator
function.description: Create a melody based on specified notes. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

note_sequence.description: The sequence of notes for the melody.

instrument.description: The instrument to play the melody, e.g. Bass.

function.name: beat_generator
function.description: Generate a beat based on specified genre and beats per minute. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

genre.description: The genre of the beat, e.g. Hip Hop.

bpm.description: The beats per minute of the beat.

scale.description: The scale for the beat, e.g. Major.
